meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Codex 与 LazyCodex 安装,揪出过时或损坏的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用 LazyCodex 或 Codex,想确认本地安装健康、与最新版一致。
copy.tagline_en: Check Codex and LazyCodex installs for drift, staleness, or breakage.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and worry your local install may be unhealthy or outdated.

howto.what: Claude 会检查本地 LazyCodex 与 Codex 的安装，下载最新源码作比对，输出每条都注明证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告；只诊断，不修改用户文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求做安装健康检查，或提到 LazyCodex、lazycodex-ai、omo-codex 等，或反映 Codex 在安装/更新/改配置后异常、怀疑安装过期损坏时触发。

say.text: 帮我诊断一下 LazyCodex 和 Codex 的安装是否健康。
say.note: 会输出带证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 体检报告。

say.text: 我更新 Codex 后插件失灵了，查查哪里出问题。
say.note: 会比对最新源码与本地配置，给出修复建议。

say.text: 检查我的 Codex 是否已支持 gpt-6-astra 模型。
say.note: 会核对版本（需不低于 0.153.1）和缓存记录。

howto.what_en: Claude audits your local LazyCodex and Codex installs, fetches the latest sources into a temporary cache for comparison, and produces a PASS/WARN/FAIL report where every verdict cites evidence. It only diagnoses; it never mutates your files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests an install health check, mentions LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or reports Codex acting oddly after an install/update/config change or suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup.

say_en.text: Check if my LazyCodex and Codex installation is healthy.
My plugin broke after updating Codex; diagnose why.
say_en.note: Compares local setup against latest sources and suggests fixes.

say_en.text: Does my Codex support the gpt-6-astra model yet?
say_en.note: Verifies the version floor and models_cache entry.
